title: Piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='45' rx='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='12' rx='5' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='33' width='72' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7a6a8a'/>
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x='16' y='48' width='68' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- key separators -->
  <g stroke='#c9bfae' stroke-width='1'>
    <line x1='25.5' y1='48' x2='25.5' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='48' x2='35' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='44.5' y1='48' x2='44.5' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='48' x2='54' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='63.5' y1='48' x2='63.5' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='48' x2='73' y2='70'/>
  </g>
  <!-- black keys -->
  <g fill='#6a4a8a'>
    <rect x='22' y='48' width='7' height='13' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='31.5' y='48' width='7' height='13' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='50.5' y='48' width='7' height='13' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='60' y='48' width='7' height='13' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='69.5' y='48' width='7' height='13' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- black key tops lit -->
  <g fill='#9a7aba'>
    <rect x='23' y='49' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='32.5' y='49' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='51.5' y='49' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='61' y='49' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='70.5' y='49' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='75' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='74' y='75' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd45e'>
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='19' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 42 19)'/>
    <rect x='45' y='8' width='2' height='11'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='24' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 62 24)'/>
    <rect x='65' y='13' width='2' height='11'/>
    <rect x='65' y='13' width='7' height='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
